caption: The drawing consists of a central dark brown eagle with outstretched wings, perched on a green and brown dome-shaped object that has vertical dark stripes. The eagle and the dome are positioned in the middle of a cream or off-white rectangular background enclosed by a thin brown border. Surrounding the eagle are four large blue five-pointed stars, each decorated with white lines or dots, placed near the corners of the bordered area. Above the eagle, in red cursive handwriting, is the phrase "E. Pluribus Unum." Below the dome, also in red cursive, is the name "William H. Burger."
title: Pieced Autograph Quilt (1 Piece)
